name: chargebee_list_subscriptions
description: List all subscriptions with optional filtering by status (e.g., 'active', 'cancelled'). Returns subscription IDs, plans, amounts, and renewal dates. Paginate with limit and offset.

status.description: Filter by subscription status: active, cancelled, non_renewing, future, in_trial, paused

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

offset.description: Pagination offset from a previous response

name: chargebee_get_subscription
description: Get full subscription details by ID. Returns plan, status, billing dates, customer info, and all charges.

name: chargebee_list_customers
description: List all customers with pagination. Returns customer IDs, names, emails, billing addresses, and creation dates.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

offset.description: Pagination offset from a previous response

name: chargebee_get_customer
description: Get complete customer profile by ID. Returns name, email, address, payment methods, subscription count, and account status.

name: chargebee_list_invoices
description: List invoices filtered by status (e.g., 'paid', 'pending') and/or customer ID. Returns invoice numbers, amounts, dates, and payment status. Paginate with limit and offset.

status.description: Filter by invoice status: paid, posted, payment_due, not_paid, voided, pending

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

offset.description: Pagination offset from a previous response
